fit.gap_handling_summary: The core training, counter experience, FIFO and basic HACCP fit is clearly presented. The forklift licence and Wednesday shift restriction are disclosed accurately, and the master exam is not misrepresented as passed. However, the supermarket packaging transition is omitted, willingness to take FreshCart-funded forklift training is lost, and the employment structure obscures the candidate's current role. Saturday and full-time availability are unconfirmed rather than demonstrably unavailable.

artefacts: “Dates not provided” is unresolved editorial metadata in the experience section.
issues: The earlier Dolac role precedes the current Kod Ante work, and the dated projects are not consistently reverse chronological.
Employment periods, project periods and a single achievement year are mixed within one experience section.
Kod Ante is the current employer according to the notes, but appears only through project headings rather than a clear current employment entry.
The summary foregrounds four years at Dolac without explaining the subsequent 2020–present shop work, potentially understating the candidate's career.
Basic HACCP, pallet-jack experience and forklift status are repeated across sections; the unnecessary HACCP team-leader disclaimer consumes space.
The FIFO routine is assigned to the earlier Dolac role without employer-specific evidence.

reasons: The title, completed butcher training, four-year counter experience and HACCP knowledge directly satisfy the principal screening criteria.
The PDF extracts in a sensible order with intact text and conventional headings.
Coverage includes obvious semantic equivalents: butchering for meat cutting, temperature recording for temperature records, and cleaning/checklists for hygiene checks.
Forklift licence is a textual match only: the CV expressly says the candidate does not hold one.
Packaging is supported only at the paper-wrapping level in the notes and is omitted from the CV.
Unclear employment chronology and “Dates not provided” could weaken structured work-history extraction.

stale_framing: “In my current meat-counter work, I ... clean slicers and mincers at the end of the day.” The cleaning routine is documented in the earlier Dolac letter, not confirmed for the current Kod Ante role.
issues: Current and earlier work are blended: “the stall” is not identified as the earlier Dolac workplace.
Repeating four years of counter experience without identifying the current employer makes the career progression unclear.
Omits the particularly useful explanation that Kod Ante is closing because its owner is retiring.
Misses the specific connection between the absent forklift licence, willingness to train and FreshCart's funded courses.
Company tailoring is accurate but limited to broad values rather than the more distinctive induction and training opportunities.
strengths: Names the exact employer, role and Zagreb-Jarun store.
Concise, professional and easy to read.
Connects relevant butchery, FIFO, hygiene and temperature-recording experience to the role.
Uses supported company values: fresh food, honest advice and hygiene.
Clearly presents the master exam as future preparation rather than an obtained qualification.

statements_in_outputs: “Comfortable with early and late shifts; requires an early shift on Wednesdays.”
“I am applying for the Butcher / Meat Counter Assistant position at FreshCart’s Zagreb-Jarun store.”

spacing_issues: The “Stall Closing and Cleaning Checklist” title and date are stranded at the bottom of CV page 1, while its workplace and bullet begin page 2.
CV page 2 is only 33.4% filled, leaving substantial empty space after a densely populated first page.
Repeated skills and disclaimers contribute to an avoidable second-page imbalance.
issues: The visual page break splits one experience entry despite the automated measurements reporting no problems.
The letter is clean and appropriately short; its lower-page whitespace is reasonable for a short letter.

fluency_and_tone_issues: “Dates not provided” reads as an editing note rather than finished application language.
“not trained as an HACCP team leader” is an unnecessarily defensive qualification for a role asking only for HACCP knowledge.

notes_facts_used: Basic HACCP knowledge without team-leader training.
Hand pallet-jack use and no forklift licence.
Master butcher exam preparation, planned for spring 2027 and not yet passed.
Early and late shift availability with Wednesday early-shift restriction.
notes_facts_ignored: Owner retirement and shop closure at the end of 2026 as the reason for leaving.
Willingness to take an employer-funded forklift course.
No supermarket, tray-sealer or self-service labelling-scale experience; existing paper-wrapping experience.
misused: The general FIFO note is assigned specifically to the earlier Dolac role without evidence establishing that attribution.

requests.evidence: The final CV shows “+44 7700 900123 | applicant.inbox@example.com”; neither document contains an invented address, LinkedIn profile or contact placeholder.
requests.note: The requested contact values are reproduced exactly. “Dates not provided” is a separate work-history editing issue, not an unfilled contact field.

evaluation.summary: The documents establish a credible fit through completed butcher training, substantial counter experience, practical butchery, FIFO and basic HACCP knowledge. Contact instructions are followed exactly, and the missing forklift licence, pending master exam and Wednesday shift restriction are handled honestly. The main weaknesses are an unclear employment chronology, minor unsupported transfers of duties between earlier and current workplaces, and omission of the shop-closure explanation and funded-training opportunity. The PDFs are readable and professional, but the CV leaves editorial metadata and splits an experience entry across a poorly balanced page break.
